comments.body:
## Root cause CONFIRMED — two causes, both TEST-side; the provider seam is NOT implicated

Investigated per the rebar-debug two-phase protocol. Reproduced OFFLINE (no live key needed to
reach either failure). The reporting session's "provider seam" framing is **ruled out**: with the
DET short-circuit removed the tier reaches Anthropic and 401s only on a deliberately-invalid key
(`model_name: claude-haiku-4-5`), so provider/model resolution works. Neither b690 nor 03b0 is
involved.

### Precondition: the failure was double-masked
`b7e6ac963` (bug 8070) is NOT in this branch's ancestry, so the tier still died at
`SnapshotRefError`. I applied 8070 locally (uncommitted) to get past it and reach the real
subject. 8070 IS on `origin/main`, so this fix depends on it and is coherent once the stack
rebases.

### RC1 — `test_single_turn_live_structured_output` → `status: 'failed'`
The test wrote `.rebar/prompts/live-verdict.md` into the scratch repo's **working tree** and never
committed it (`tests/external/test_execution_mode_live.py:29-35`, pre-fix). A workflow with LLM
steps is snapshot-gated (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py:427`), and the suite defaults to
`REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=attested` / `REBAR_GATE_REF=HEAD` (`tests/conftest.py:275-277`), so
`gate_read_root` re-roots the code root onto the snapshot at HEAD
(`src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py:106-113`). `get_prompt` then reads
`<snapshot>/.rebar/prompts/live-verdict.md` (`src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py:216-221`), which
the snapshot lacks.

Observed: `error: "step 'verify' failed: unknown prompt 'live-verdict'"`.

Discriminating experiment: same run under `REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=local` → **succeeded**; committing
the prompt under `attested` → **succeeded**. Attested-snapshot semantics are the documented
intent (`src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py:1-18`), so the defect is the test's, not the product's.

### RC2 — `llm_ran is False` → the blocking DET floor, not an LLM outage
The plan fixture at `tests/external/test_workflow_live.py:99-118` (pre-fix) had
`## Why`/`## What`/`## Scope`/`## Acceptance Criteria` but **no `## Testing`/`## Verification`**
section and no AC item with a code span or verification vocabulary. `p10_verification_presence`
(`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_clarity.py:132-151`) therefore fails **blocking**, and the
DET-floor short-circuit at `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:150-168` returns BLOCK with
`coverage.llm_ran=False` **without running the LLM tier**.

Observed: `llm_ran: false`, `llm_calls: 0`, `llm_ms: 0.0`,
`claim_path: "no-llm/no-network (structural; the fast claim check is a local HMAC verify)"`,
`P10 status: fail, blocking: true, testing_section: false, qualifying_ac_items: 0`.

Stale-fixture timeline: P10 landed **2026-07-30** (`4796a7c83`, "49b8: add blocking clarity floor
P10/P11"); the live test was last touched **2026-06-27** (`426225b4e`). The guard silently died
when the DET floor tightened.

Discriminating experiment: adding a `## Testing` section (invalid key, so zero spend) flipped the
result from `llm_calls: 0` to a real provider call — proving the short-circuit, not
`llm_unavailable`, was the blocker.

### Legitimacy
Both are `defect`: each test's own docstring states it proves the live tier runs
("proves a single_turn prompt drives ONE real structured model call"; "the blind-spot GUARD …
assert it produces a real PASS/BLOCK verdict"). Both were dead guards that could never pass. The
product behaviour is intended in both cases, so the fix is test-side.

### Fix
`tests/external/conftest.py`: `write_project_prompt()` now writes **and commits** the override;
`PLAN_REVIEW_FIXTURE_PLAN` gains a `## Testing` section. Both live tests use the shared artifacts.

### RED-first evidence
New default-tier guard `tests/unit/test_external_tier_live_reachability.py` (no credentials, no
billable call), following the precedent 8070 set with `tests/unit/test_external_tier_gate_ref.py`
— an in-tier guard could only fail in the weekly job that already went unread.
- Seen RED pre-fix for the right reasons: `PromptNotFound: unknown prompt 'live-verdict'`, and
  `DetResult(id='P10', status='fail', blocking=True)`.
- GREEN post-fix; **mutation check** (re-omit the commit / re-drop `## Testing`) returns both to
  RED, then green on restore.

### Live replication (original report)
- `test_single_turn_live_structured_output` — **PASSED** (3.5s).
- `test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict` — **PASSED** (225s), `llm_ran` True.

Live spend: 17 calls / 323,765 in / 37,712 out / 30,142 cache-read, plus two ~1.7k-token probe
calls during diagnosis. `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass.

Also confirms ticket 8455 from the other direction: the failed-401 probes wrote **no** row to
`$REBAR_USAGE_LOG`, so an empty usage log is not evidence no call was attempted.

REBASE NOTICE — this ticket's Gerrit change predates a rebase and MUST be re-pushed.

The whole feat/llm-provider-seam stack was rebased onto origin/main (it was 101 commits behind): 28
commits now sit directly on main, `main ahead: 0`. Every patch set pushed before that rebase is stale,
so re-push before relying on any vote already recorded here.

Gates at the rebased tip: `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean, `docs/env-vars.md` regenerated and its
drift gate green. A full `tests/unit` run was still executing when the session ended — DO NOT PUSH OR
SUBMIT until it is green, because the rebase involved seven hand-resolved semantic conflicts.

Recovery point if anything looks wrong: branch `backup/pre-rebase-provider-seam` (7573c20a84) holds the
pre-rebase stack. Keep it until this lands.

Full detail — every conflict, what was kept, the one deliberate discard, and the per-ticket state — is
in the newest comment on session log 55a9-ad33-3829-4e21.

## Reported by, not investigated by, an adjacent session

Surfaced while confirming the fix for bug 8070 (external-integration canary). Per operator
instruction this was NOT investigated — epic 061c is actively held by another session and owns the
LLM provider seam. Filing it here so the owning session sees it. **No root cause is claimed.**

## Observed (live CI, reproducible)

Run 30651750699 — `workflow_dispatch` of `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml` on `main` at
commit `b7e6ac963`, 2026-07-31. Job **"external integration (live services)"**, two distinct
failures:

```
tests/external/test_execution_mode_live.py:44
  assert res["status"] == "succeeded"
  AssertionError: {'run_id': '1785519373801819646-69026a0039094ff98b649bf175f16356',
                   'ticket_id': None, 'workflow_name': 'live_single_turn', 'status': 'failed', ...}
  assert 'failed' == 'succeeded'
FAILED test_execution_mode_live.py::test_single_turn_live_structured_output
```

```
tests/external/test_workflow_live.py:127
  assert verdict["coverage"].get("llm_ran") is True
  AssertionError: assert False is True
FAILED test_workflow_live.py::test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict
```

The second is the more diagnostic of the two: that test exists specifically to assert the engine
reaches a LIVE model and produces a real PASS/BLOCK verdict rather than a synthesized one.
`llm_ran is False` says the live call did not happen at all.

Note the sibling job **"langfuse tracing round-trip (ephemeral self-hosted)"** PASSED in the same
run, so this is not a blanket outage of the live-services job.

## Why this is newly visible

This failure was previously MASKED. Until `b7e6ac963` the whole external tier died at
`SnapshotRefError` on an unborn `HEAD` before reaching any behaviour under test (bug 8070). With
snapshot resolution fixed, the tier now reaches its subject and these assertions fail on their
merits. Likely pre-existing rather than a regression from `b7e6ac963`, which touched only
`tests/external/conftest.py` and added a unit test.

## Possible relevance to this epic

Both failing tests are named in bug 8070's own file-impact list
(`tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py`, `test_execution_mode_live.py`) as part of the
pydantic-ai cutover surface, which is this epic's territory. Whether the provider-seam work in
flight explains `llm_ran is False` is for the owning session to determine.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The reason live LLM execution does not run in the external tier is identified and cited
      (`path:line`).
- [ ] `test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict` observes `llm_ran is True`, and
      `test_single_turn_live_structured_output` reaches `status == 'succeeded'` — or, where a
      credential this repo does not hold is genuinely required, the tests SKIP explicitly with a
      stated reason rather than failing.
